tools.name: search_lists
tools.description: Search Listomancy's hand-written checklists and routines by words (every word must match the title, description or an item). Empty query lists them all. Returns title, description, item count and the page URL.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Full content of one list by slug (the last part of its URL): sections with their items, plus the page, Markdown, Todoist CSV and text export URLs, the embed URL and a QR code URL.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Publish a new list and get its public link (page, exports, QR). Give either "items" (flat) or "sections" (grouped). Lists are immutable and unlisted (not indexed, not in the catalogue); to change one, create a new one with from_slug. Without an API key: 5 lists per day; with a key from register_agen

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Optional. Issue an API key for your agent (shown once, keep it) and send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" to get higher rate limits (120 requests per minute, 50 created lists per day). Not needed to read or to create a few lists.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_lists, get_list, register_agent · Private data: create_list, register_agent · Public sink: create_list, register_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_lists, get_list, register_agent · Private data: create_list, register_agent · Public sink: create_list, register_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
